title: OPERATING SYSTEMS, II
description: Continuation of COMS W4118 , with emphasis on distributed operating systems. Topics include interfaces to network protocols, distributed run-time binding, advanced virtual memory issues, advanced means of interprocess communication, file system design, design for extensibility, security in a distributed environment. Investigation is deeper and more hands-on than in COMS W4118 . A programming project is required.
prerequisites_text: Prerequisites: ( COMS W4118 ) COMS W4118 Corequisites: COMS W4119
